paragraph: The Granville composite registers a constructive 63 out of 100 with no active breadth divergence, establishing our primary verdict as a net bullish operational posture. Market internals reflect sturdy offensive sponsorship, spearheaded by bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +1.37%), defensive outflows (XLP/XLY -0.60%), and aggressive high-beta allocation (SPHB/SPLV +1.03%), which comfortably outweigh the cyclical drag from deteriorating transports (IYT/SPY -1.62%) and subdued equal-weight participation (RSP/SPY -0.28%). On the macro front, high-yield credit spreads widening to 3.40% and an elevated VIX at 20.15 (up 5.89%) demand caution, but broader systemic stress remains contained by a persistent volatility contango running from 15.4 to 20.9 alongside back-loaded 1D/30D skew at -4.8 points. Maintain a cautiously bullish directional lean for the session, favoring dip-buying in high-beta and tech leadership while using transport weakness as a guide for tighter stops.
